subject: ClarifyHealth renewal - request for price-match + migration playbook
messages:
From: Ethan Patel <ethan.patel@clarifyhealth.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@clarifyhealth.com
Date: 2026-08-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: ClarifyHealth renewal - we received a competitive quote

Hi Stephanie,

Hope you’re well — our renewal is coming up and procurement handed me a competitive offer from NimbusAI (attached). They’re proposing a 12-month fixed-rate package that undercuts our current run-rate by ~18% and includes a migration allowance and a 30% pilot credit.

We’ve been happy with Redwood’s latency and observability, but the dollar delta is material for execs. Can Redwood provide a comparable price-match + migration assistance? Specifically:
- 12 month locked rate equal or better than NimbusAI on equivalent token tiers
- a one-time migration credit or onboarding fee offset
- short pilot credits to validate performance/latency (90 day)

I’m including procurement on this thread. Would appreciate a written match or a counter that preserves our economics.

Thanks,
Ethan Patel
Director, Platform Engineering
ClarifyHealth

Attachment: RivalQuote_NimbusAI_2026-08-26.pdf (pdf, 215KB)
From: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Patel <ethan.patel@clarifyhealth.com>
Cc: connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-29T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ClarifyHealth renewal - request for price-match + migration playbook

Hi Ethan — thanks for the heads up and for sharing the Nimbus quote. I get why procurement is pressing on price. We value ClarifyHealth as a strategic customer and I’d like to propose a concrete path:

High-level proposal (draft):
- 12-month committed term with tiered consumption pricing that matches Nimbus on core token bands (we can make the top two bands identical).
- One-time migration credit of $45k to cover integration/egress costs.
- 25% pilot credit on first 90 days (applied as bill credit).
- SLA uplift to 99.9% with explicit latency targets on critical routes (addendum).

I’ve attached a price comparison sheet and a short term sheet we can finalize with billing/legal. Can you confirm: (1) expected average monthly tokens, (2) must-have latency SLOs, and (3) procurement contact for contract redlines?

If that sounds OK, let’s do a 30-minute call tomorrow 10am PT so I can walk product/legal through the specifics.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai

Attachment: price_comparison_sheet.xlsx (xlsx, stub)

Date: 2026-08-29T13:10:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: ClarifyHealth renewal - request for price-match + migration playbook

Connor / Neha — forwarding Ethan’s note. He’s asked for a written match + migration credit. Quick internal checklist before the 10am call:

On the call I’ll need:
- Confirmed margin floor if we match Nimbus on top tiers (can we preserve at least 22% blended margin?)
- Legal: can we commit to the 99.9% SLA with latency addendum for the two critical routes?
- Engineering: migration runbook estimate and whether $45k is realistic for a one-time credit (covers egress + 2-week SRE engagement).

Ethan expects numbers. I want to avoid a drawn-out counter; if we can close with the draft above we likely retain the account. Thoughts?

—Steph

From: connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-08-29T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: ClarifyHealth renewal - request for price-match + migration playbook

Stephanie — quick read:

- Margin: if we match Nimbus on the two main bands we can keep ~20% blended margin assuming we tighten caching defaults and recommend int8 quant on their baseline models. If they push all traffic to top-tier tokens we lose more.
- Migration credit: $45k seems fine as a commercial concession; we make it conditional on a 12-month committed term and a max 30 day cutover window.
- Pilot credit: 25% is reasonable but shift to credits applied to first 60 days unless they insist on 90. Keeps exposure lower.
- SLA uplift: Legal will want clear exception/penalty language — suggest a service credit not full fee forgiveness.

I’ll join the 10am call and bring a one-pager on runtime/quantization opportunities we can use to sell operational savings on top.

Connor
Staff Sales Engineer
connor_obrien@redwood.ai
From: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Patel <ethan.patel@clarifyhealth.com>
Cc: connor_obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, procurement@clarifyhealth.com
Date: 2026-08-30T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood price-match proposal for ClarifyHealth renewal (draft term sheet)

Hi Ethan — thanks for the call today. Per our discussion, attached is a draft term sheet and migration playbook. Highlights below:

- Term: 12 months committed (CH-2026-004)
- Pricing: Tiered consumption schedule that matches NimbusAI in bands A/B (see term sheet). Band C discounted by 5% relative to Nimbus (keeps us competitive if they spike).
- Migration credit: $45,000 one-time credit applied against month 1 invoice; conditional on signed term and migration complete within 30 days of go-live.
- Pilot credits: 25% applied to first 60 days to validate performance (applies as one-time credit).
- SLA addendum: 99.9% uptime on critical inference routes; service credits up to 10% of monthly invoice for SLA violations (legal to finalize).

Next steps:
1) Procurement to send redline window (we can accept commercial redlines within 48 hours).
2) Legal to confirm SLA language.
3) Engineering onboarding plan kickoff within 5 business days of signed term.

Attachments: ClarifyHealth_Migration_Playbook_v1.pdf, price_match_term_sheet.docx

If that looks acceptable I’ll put together a final contract and request exec approval for the concession package.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai

Stephanie — appreciate the quick turnaround and the clarity. The deal points are in line with what procurement needed; two small asks before we route to execs: (1) extend the pilot credit to 75 days (procurement preference), and (2) confirm that the migration credit can be invoiced as an onboarding credit rather than netted (for our accounting).

If you can accept those two items I’ll get procurement to send the redline and we can aim to sign next week.

Thanks,
Ethan Patel
Director, Platform Engineering
ClarifyHealth
